tool_config.name: submit_requests
tool_config.description: Record the Foreman's need as a Request. Call it only after you have read back the Job, quantity, unit and needed-by time and the Foreman said yes. Returns [{"ref": "R-1042", "needed_by_resolved": "Monday, November 2 at 7:00 AM", "urgency": "Planned"}] with the reference number, or {"error": "..."} if the request could not be saved.

items.description: Exactly one item: the need the Foreman confirmed.

job_id.description: The job_id that find_jobs returned for the Job the Foreman confirmed. Leave it out when find_jobs found no Job (Unmatched). Never spoken.

job_spoken.description: The Job exactly as the Foreman said it, for example 'the 104 job'. Always sent, matched or not.

need.description: What is needed, in the Foreman's words, for example 'tri-axle dump truck'.

quantity.description: How many, as a number, if the Foreman gave one.

unit.description: The unit of the quantity, for example 'trucks', 'loads', 'tons'.

needed_by_spoken.description: When it is needed, exactly as the Foreman said it, for example 'tomorrow at seven'. Do not convert it. Leave it out when the Foreman could not say when (needed-by unknown).
